# `pacvamp channel`

- **Usage:** `pacvamp channel [--offline] [-J --json] <SUBCOMMAND>`

Show the channel and snapshot this machine follows, or pin one

The channel comes from the Omarchy repository's server URL. Its signed release manifest says which snapshot the channel points at, whether it passed the test suite, when it was promoted, and which packages were exercised. `pin` freezes the Arch mirror on a snapshot; `unpin` restores the mirrorlist that was in place before.

## Global Flags
- **`--offline`** — Use the cached feeds only
- **`-J --json`** — Print as JSON

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`pacvamp channel pin [--force] <ID>`](/cli/pacvamp/channel/pin.md)
